source_instruction: i need to buy a height adjustable office chair with lumbar support. i want a grey one.
query: I spent most of my morning chasing my neighbor’s escape artist tabby cat all around the apartment complex after it snuck out through a cracked screen door when they were hauling in grocery bags. That cat is so fast it zipped past three different dog walkers, hopped up on the second floor landing of the building next door, and even tried to sneak into the community garden where the old man who grows tomatoes always chases strays away. I finally cornered it under a picnic table by the mailboxes ten minutes later, covered in dandelion fluff and with my favorite hoodie string chewed half through from when the cat clamped down on it mid-wriggle. I’ve heard that the home office chairs I’m browsing right now that have proper lumbar support, come in grey, and are priced at a really reasonable rate, nothing that feels like a total ripoff, fit really well for what works for people. I’ve heard those same chairs also have all the standard good adjustability features people look for in a desk chair, right? I’ve heard none of those options feel flimsy or like they’ll break after a couple weeks of use for my work from home setup.
